title: Fix and ensure mobile Left/Right on-screen buttons reliably control the player car

requirements.text: Make the mobile on-screen Left and Right buttons reliably steer the player car in-game by ensuring press-and-hold sets the shared control state and release/cancel always clears it, across mobile touch and pointer input.

quotes: Abhi aisa karo ismein na vah gadi to jo left wala button hai aur right wala button Hai is per control hona chahie gadi ka mobile laga do left or right ke button ki gadi control left or right button per honi chahie vah laga do uske

acceptanceCriteria: On a mobile device, pressing and holding the Left button moves the car left by at least one lane (when possible).
On a mobile device, pressing and holding the Right button moves the car right by at least one lane (when possible).
If the user lifts their finger outside the button area (touch cancel / pointer cancel), the corresponding control state is cleared and the car does not keep steering.
The on-screen controls do not trigger unwanted page scrolling/zooming while playing (no accidental browser gestures caused by the control presses).

requirements.text: Update the touch control event handling to use robust mobile-safe events (pointer events and/or touch start/end + touch cancel) for Left/Right (and Brake if present), without changing gameplay logic other than making the controls responsive.

quotes: mobile laga do left or right ke button ki gadi control left or right button per honi chahie

acceptanceCriteria: TouchControls provides consistent behavior on Android Chrome: press sets control true, release sets it false, and cancel sets it false.
No regression: keyboard ArrowLeft/ArrowRight controls continue to work as before.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only UI components).
Keep the backend as-is; this change should be frontend-only.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Adding new gameplay features beyond making Left/Right mobile controls work reliably (e.g., new levels, new vehicles, multiplayer).
Changing the game’s core movement/scoring/collision logic beyond what is required to correctly apply the existing left/right control state.
